name: FT Vest Laddered Max Buffer ETF
name_en: FT Vest Laddered Max Buffer ETF
desc: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by providing investors with U.S. large-cap equity market exposure while fund manager attempting to limit downside risk through a laddered portfolio of twelve FT Vest U.S. Equity Max Buffer ETFs. Under normal market conditions, it will invest substantially all of its assets in the Underlying ETFs, which seek to provide investors with returns that match the price return of SPY, up to a predetermined upside cap, while providing the maximum available buffer against SPY losses, over a defined one-year period.
